english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the mythical phoenix, especially the Chinese phoenix.

examples.english: In legend, the phoenix is reborn from the flames every five hundred years.
examples.traditional: 傳說入面，鳳凰五百年就浴火重生一次。
